Order
Present revision is filed under Section 397 read with Section 401 of Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973 (herein after referred to as the Code) challenging order dated 11.04.2023 (Annexure P/4)
passed by learned Seventeenth Additional Sessions Judge, Indore, District Indore in Miscellaneous Judicial Case (Criminal) bearing registration number MJCR No.1095 of 2023, whereby the learned Sessions Judge has declined to extend period of two months time to deposit an amount of Rs.50,000/- (rupees fifty thousand) towards fine.

sentences.text:
2. Brief facts of the case are that vide judgment and order dated 10.01.2023 (Annexure P/1) passed Komalchand vs Indore Municipal Corporation on 21 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/38809398/
1 by learned Seventeenth Additional Sessions Judge, Indore, Criminal Appeal No.231 of 2017 filed by present petitioner - appellant was partly allowed by enhancing fine amount of Rs.1,000/- (Rupees one thousand) to Rs.50,000/- (Rupees fifty thousand) in lieu of jail sentence of six months rigorous imprisonment imposed upon him for offence under Section 7 (i) read with Section 16 (i) A (i) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 by the trial Court.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the enhanced fine amount of Rs.50,000/- (rupees fifty thousand) could not be deposited within a period of two months, as he is aged about 78 years and suffering from loss of memory, however, his son has deposited the said amount with a delay of eleven days.

4. Keeping the aforesaid submission and exercising the powers under Section 482 read with Section 397 of the Code, the period of two months, as fixed by the learned Sessions Judge, is extended to a period of two months and eleven days.
5. With the aforesaid observation, Criminal Revision No.3587 of 2023 stands disposed off.

(VIVEK RUSIA) JUDGE rcp Komalchand vs Indore Municipal Corporation on 21 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/38809398/
